entities.name: Michiyo Tsujimura
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michiyo Tsujimura  was a Japanese agricultural scientist and biochemist whose research focused on the components of green tea. She was the first woman in Japan to receive a doctoral degree in agriculture.
